faqAccordionItems.question: What is the purpose of a behind-the-wheel lesson?
faqAccordionItems.answerHtml: Behind-the-wheel lessons give Nevada students real, hands-on driving experience. They’re designed to build skills and confidence needed to become safe, responsible drivers.

faqAccordionItems.question: Who can take a behind-the-wheel lesson?
faqAccordionItems.answerHtml: Teens, adults, and international drivers seeking Nevada driving experience are welcome. We tailor lessons to your skill level.

faqAccordionItems.question: What will I learn in a behind-the-wheel lesson?
faqAccordionItems.answerHtml: Core vehicle control, lane changes, turns, speed & space management, defensive driving, parking, and route planning. Advanced packages add freeway and night driving.

faqAccordionItems.question: How many lessons do I need?
faqAccordionItems.answerHtml: It depends on your starting level and confidence. Many students begin with a Starter or Explorer pack; we’ll recommend a plan after your first lesson.

faqAccordionItems.question: How much does it cost?
faqAccordionItems.answerHtml: See package pricing above. Multi-lesson packs include built-in savings and flexible scheduling.
